mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as of t-1mo indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% (as of t-1mo) signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases the risk-free rate and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 0.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals an accelerating labor market deterioration, which triggers a flight to quality and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 900 and INDPRO > 100), the economy is overheating, leading to a higher probability of recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 900 and INDPRO > 100 (as of t-2mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% (as of t-1mo) signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is above 7.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) as of t-2mo indicates strong economic activity and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above 850 (as of t-2mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 (as of t-2mo) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 95 (as of t-2mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 232.0 (as of t-1mo) signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a short-term risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 232.0 (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
